name: limit-revive
description: When the 5-hour or weekly usage limit passes a set percent with work unfinished, resume the session automatically at reset + N minutes; when the weekly reset is too far off, stop cleanly instead.

thresholdPercent.title: Threshold (%)
thresholdPercent.description: 5-hour usage percent at which limit-revive gets involved.

delayMinutes.title: Delay after reset (minutes)
delayMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after the 5-hour window resets before resuming.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: resume-only: never interrupt, resume only a turn that died on the limit. finish-turn: let the turn finish, hold new prompts until reset. stop-now: abort the running turn at the threshold and resume it later.

resumePrompt.title: Resume prompt
resumePrompt.description: Text submitted to the session when it is revived.
resumePrompt.default: The usage limit has reset. Continue exactly where you left off.

windowsFallback.title: Windows Task Scheduler fallback
windowsFallback.description: Windows only: also schedule a one-shot Task Scheduler job that reopens the session (claude --resume) if its window was closed. Ignored on macOS and Linux.

weeklyEnabled.title: Watch the weekly limit
weeklyEnabled.description: Also act on the weekly (7-day) usage limit, so a revive never resumes into an exhausted week.

weeklyThresholdPercent.title: Weekly threshold (%)
weeklyThresholdPercent.description: Weekly usage percent at which limit-revive gets involved.

weeklyReviveWithinHours.title: Weekly revive window (hours)
weeklyReviveWithinHours.description: If the weekly limit resets within this many hours, wait for it and resume like the 5-hour revive (same mode, delay and Windows task). If it resets later, stop as Weekly mode says and schedule nothing.

weeklyMode.title: Weekly mode
weeklyMode.description: When the weekly reset is further away than the revive window. finish-turn: let the running turn finish, then hold off new prompts until the reset. stop-now: abort the running turn once. notify-only: a toast and a note to Claude, nothing stopped. /limit-revive cancel pushes through until the reset.
